subject.title: BL-ecommerce-authors: Authors — specs, aislamiento y tests

question: Should danielmenchen-hamelyn validate the extracted Ecommerce Authors rules and sitemap flag before any isolation/tests proceed?
rationale: The Hamelyn BL pipeline makes F2 owner validation blocking, and this issue has live code plus at least one flagged behavior question that automation should not decide alone.

options.title: Run owner-led F2 first
options.body: Extract the draft specs, resolve all flags with the named owner, then proceed to isolation and tests only for validated rules.

options.title: Defer the block
options.body: Keep the issue open but leave the Authors block queued until higher-priority Ecommerce BL areas finish.

options.title: Narrow the scope
options.body: Limit this issue to the author detail page rules and open a separate issue for sitemap behavior if the owner treats it as SEO scope.

recommendation.title: Run owner-led F2 first
recommendation.body: Extract the draft specs, resolve all flags with the named owner, then proceed to isolation and tests only for validated rules.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the named owner and current assignee for the BL block.
